displayName.description: Human-readable branch name presented to the user.

target.description: Exact local or remote ref used as the review target.

baseBranch.description: Display name of the pull request's base branch, when supplied by GitHub.

baseBranchTarget.description: Exact local or remote ref for the pull request base, when it resolved unambiguously.

branches.description: Available explicit base-branch targets, with the preferred target first.

commits.description: Recent commits reachable from HEAD, capped at 100 entries.

currentBranch.description: Currently checked-out branch, or `null` for a detached head or non-repository cwd.

defaultBranch.description: Detected repository default branch, when one was found.

doubleCheckAvailable.description: Whether the server supports the isolated Double-check stage.

error.description: Short diagnostic shown when Git repository detection failed.

fixExecutionAvailable.description: Whether Fix actions can use the required workspace-write profile on the server.

fixUnavailableReason.description: Short diagnostic when Fix actions are unavailable.

hasUncommittedChanges.description: Whether staged, unstaged, or untracked changes are present.

pullRequest.description: Open pull request associated with the selected checkout, when one was found.

reviewExecutionAvailable.description: Whether reviews can run on the selected executor with the server's active sandbox setup.

reviewUnavailableReason.description: Short diagnostic when review execution is unavailable.

wholeRepositoryAvailable.description: Whether the server supports the whole-repository review target.
